svg.desc: DNS-01 proves domain ownership without making Hubble public.

g.text: DNS-01 proves domain ownership without making Hubble public.
Use protected temporary input. Keep plaintext and tokens out of Git and arguments.
cert-manager waits for the public TXT record to propagate.
cert-manager removes the challenge TXT and renews before expiry.
DNS-01 does not require a public HTTP listener.
